Chapter 658 - 658 Revenge Must Be Taken; The Heavenly Hound Appears!

Chapter 658 - 658 Revenge Must Be Taken; The Heavenly Hound Appears!

658 Revenge Must Be Taken; The Heavenly Hound Appears!

The setting sun was like fire, but it made the man feel like he was in the middle of winter.

Awe-inspiring and cold…

His entire body trembled.

Even though Lin Fan was just a young man, in the man’s eyes, he was like a bloodthirsty God of Death.

He opened his mouth and stammered, “You… You’ve misunderstood…”

Lin Fan did not say anything else and snapped his fingers.

The man was like a balloon, instantly bursting into a bloody mist.

The man did not say anything.

However, he already knew the answer in his heart.

‘What kind of terrifying existence did Boss Chen ask me to kill? What should we do now?’

Those who killed would be killed!

Lin Fan naturally would not hold back.

At this moment, the phone on the ground vibrated.

Lin Fan tapped it, and a low voice rang out.

“Has it been resolved?”

Lin Fan said, “I’m afraid I’ll have to disappoint you.”

“Who are you?” The voice on the phone suddenly turned cold.

“Lin Fan,” Lin Fan said.

“You’re actually capable of killing my people. Who are you?” The voice on the phone was extremely low.

Lin Fan said, “You’ll see me soon.”

“Is that so? Then I’ll wait for you!” After saying that, he hung up the phone.

Lin Fan looked at the super smart watch on his wrist and said, “Little White!”

“Master, I’ve already locked onto his identity and location.” The super smart watch flickered slightly and made a very clear sound.

Then, a 3D projection appeared in front of Lin Fan. It contained all kinds of information about Boss Chen, including his family, company, projects, and so on.

For an ordinary person, even if they wanted to finish reading all this information, they would probably have to spend a very long time.

However, Lin Fan took a single glance and memorized all the information.

“Chen Ming?” Lin Fan said, “Is the mastermind Chen Ming?”

He had interacted with Chen Ming twice.

The first time was at the student union’s gala, where the two of them played the piano.

The second time was in Forbidden Area No. 31. Chen Ming stayed behind to explore with Class 2011.

Later, when Chen Ming was taking a dump, he was beaten up by someone, causing him to be covered in shit.

Lin Fan recorded everything down.

In a sense, Chen Ming also had a grudge against Li Dongqiang.

However, Lin Fan did not really care about that.

He only looked at the results.

Chen Ming wanted to kill him!

Lin Fan did not like Chen Ming to begin with. Now, he had attacked him.

In that case, he definitely could not let it go.

Then, Lin Fan stepped out.

His entire person instantly disappeared from where he was.

…

At this moment, in a slightly dark basement.

Chen Weiqiang frowned and said, “Who exactly did Chen Ming offend?”

The next moment, a tall and handsome young man suddenly appeared in front of him.

It was Lin Fan!

“Why are you here?” Chen Weiqiang asked in surprise.

Lin Fan said indifferently, “Is your memory bad? I just said that we’d meet soon.”

Then, he snapped his fingers again.

Chen Weiqiang exploded instantly, turning into wisps of blood mist.

Following that, Lin Fan’s body flashed once more.

…

At this moment, in Fenghua Club.

Chen Ming walked into the private room with a voluptuous woman in his arms.

Without a word, he violently pressed down on the woman’s head.

He had been like this for the past few days.

He needed to vent all the humiliation he endured in the forbidden area.

“Lin Fan, are you dead?” Chen Ming said sternly. “You must’ve died a horrible death!”

“Unfortunately, I’ve disappointed you.” An indifferent voice suddenly sounded behind him.

When Chen Ming heard this, he could not help but shiver.

“Why are you here?” he asked in surprise.

Lin Fan could not help but say, “Your Chen family doesn’t seem to be much. Unfortunately, it won’t end well for you.”

Chen Ming’s body suddenly exploded, and blood spurted out.

The gorgeous woman, who was originally puzzled, could not help but let out an ear-piercing scream when she saw this.

However, this cry only reverberated within half a meter of her.

It was as if her entire body was isolated in an invisible thick glass.

Lin Fan pointed out casually, and the gorgeous woman fainted.

With that, Lin Fan took a step forward and disappeared from where he was.

When the gorgeous woman woke up, she had completely forgotten what had happened.

She muttered to herself in a daze, “Why am I here?”

…

Lin Fan did not continue his killing spree.

After all, no one else had provoked him yet.

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

Today, the Heavenly Hound tattoo on Lin Fan’s arm started to squirm.

In the next moment, a large dog about two meters long appeared in front of him.

It was the Heavenly Hound.

When the Heavenly Hound saw Lin Fan, it could not help but wag its tail happily.

Obviously, it was very happy.

This was normal.

One had to know…

A thousand years ago, the Heavenly Hound had established a contract with Lin Fan.

During these 1,000 years, Lin Fan had been absorbing the energy of the orb of light. The Heavenly Hound had been by his side the entire time.

In other words, Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound had been together for a thousand years.

A thousand-year-old friendship surpassed everything!

When Lin Fan caught sight of the Heavenly Hound, he smiled and said, “Heavenly Hound, you’re finally awake.”

“Master, I missed you so much.”

After signing the contract, Lin Fan was the owner of the Heavenly Hound!

As soon as he finished speaking, the Heavenly Hound stuck out its tongue and was about to lick Lin Fan.

Lin Fan dodged to the side and said, “This is Earth, which is also where I live. Shrink yourself to this size, and then behave yourself.”

The place where Master lived?

The Heavenly Hound’s eyes lit up. It shrunk its body and looked around curiously.

Lin Fan patted its head and said, “Alright, let’s go.”

Today, Jiangbei University was as lively as usual.

Lin Fan walked through the green path and walked past the basketball court. He went straight to the classroom of Class 2011.

At this moment, a man with a ponytail called Qiao Kai was walking into the classroom with a four-eyed dog that was half the height of a person.

A thousand years ago, animals were generally not allowed to enter the classroom.

However, there was no such rule in the current world.

This was because animals were no longer just pets. They were partners and comrades!

The classroom was immediately filled with gasps of admiration.

“It’s a Four-Eyed Hell Hound!”

“That’s so cool!”

“This is my first time seeing a Four-Eyed Hell Hound in real life!”

…

Qiao Kai heard everyone’s praises and felt extremely happy in his heart.

“Qiao Kai, where did you get this Four-Eyed Hell Hound?” someone asked.

“My dad gave it to me after he found out that I became a special ability user in Forbidden Area No. 31,” Qiao Kai said with a smile.

“You obtained the earth attribute ability,” someone beside him said. “With the addition of the Four-Eyed Hell Hound, your strength will definitely increase by several times!”
